patterns.text: On days with 10k+ steps, you tend to sleep 24 min longer that night.
patterns.detail: Based on 41 days with 10k+ steps and 96 without, last 180 days.

patterns.text: After workouts that end after 8 pm, your next-morning HRV tends to be 6% lower.
patterns.detail: Based on 12 late workouts and 38 earlier ones, last 180 days.

patterns.text: After nights under 6 hours, your resting heart rate tends to be 2.4 bpm higher.
patterns.detail: Based on 9 short nights and 88 nights of 7 hours or more, last 180 days.
